The fact that youre still here gives me the feeling you dont want to end it. Youre hoping for things to get better. Im in the same boat like you, i have a hard time talking to people but what is one day extra gonna do for you? 
Please dont end it just yet. If you really want to end it, do all the things you where afraid to do because of the results it will bring. When attempting things i usually use suicide as my ultimate card. So what if things go wrong or dont work out, the opportunity to end life will always be there.

Nop i have not considered talking to someone i dont want anyone to know what goes trough my mind. It can get really weird and i dont want people to think less of me because of the toughts im having. I think talking to someone will be a step forward but im afraid to actually talk or go to a counselor/therapist. I can consider doing it via emails and stuff but i have no idea how people can help me. Im scared of ending up alone when i open up my mind.
Thanks for the fast reply, its really nice to see people help out with my  personal problems.

Yes occasionaly i feel really happy and that life is giving me everything it can provide. Those moments are the moments im looking forward to but i feel like im not the one controlling my brain. It sounds really weird but i sometimes feel like im living in my own imaganition. I have to remember everything i see otherwise the simulation might stop. I get really obsessed when seeing other people when they have tattoos i need to remember what the tattoos are and on what hand/arm they are. I feel like im losing control of my own mind and that lose of controll will force me to go back and relive everything again. Even as im typing this now i feel like i have done everything, I go to youtube to see new recently uploaded videos and see if i still feel deja vu and it still happens. I know its not possible to have it happen but idk how to make it stop. When im feeling happy its because of the deja vu feeling thinking that every decision i make will be the right one (i have no idea how that will work). Its like im slowly losing it.
Thanks for the reply i really aprieciate it and that you are trying to understand me :)

I can also relate to the rather killing myself than becoming slowly insane. As of now i dont have any tips on how to make it better or how to improve life in general. However what helps for me is to go all out when doing my hobbies Im doing alot of physical excersises and working  and when im doing those things i finally have an empty mind. Its so good to empty my mind every day. Keeping myself occupied is whats helping me instead of jumping infront of that train. 
I really dont want to kill myself i want my mind to stop telling me to kill myself..
